items.title: Cereal, Mac and Cheese and Bacon Are in Almost Every Pantry. $60,000 in Each of the Companies Behind Them Pays $11,282 a Year
items.summary: Cheerios, Kraft Mac & Cheese and Hormel bacon fill your cupboards, yet the stocks behind them have slumped and their yields have swelled. Which payout looks safest, and which risk could trip up a retiree counting on those checks?

items.title: General Mills streamlines business structure amid CEO change
items.summary: The Cheerios maker is reorganizing into three operating segments as it looks to enhance its focus and accelerate growth.

items.title: General Mills Announces Three-Segment Operating Structure Effective January 2027
items.summary: General Mills (NYSE:GIS) announced plans to reorganise its operations into three business segments beginning January 1, 2027, as part of changes to its management structure and commercial operations. The Minneapolis-based food manufacturer will operate through Cereal, Snacks & International; Meals & Baking Solutions; and Pet.

items.title: General Mills wants a bigger bite of $32B salty snack space
items.summary: The food giant is intensifying the flavors and adding new packaging options for Chex Mix and its other snacks, aiming to boost its 1% share of the category.
